title: Active-set Picard iteration against the exact management oracle
purpose: Test a naive hydrology-management active-set Picard iteration against the exact DUMMY-05 piecewise oracle, separating correctness of the priority rule from convergence of a coupling algorithm.
hypotheses: Every admissible DUMMY-05 exact solution is a fixed point of this active-set map.
Inside the CURTAILED regime the provisional end level is exactly hmin, so one map evaluation returns the exact curtailed exchange independent of lambda.
Inside fixed FULL or ZERO regimes the local exchange error factor remains -lambda from DUMMY-04.
Management clipping keeps U within [0,R] but does not guarantee convergence of the coupled iteration.
A preregistered lambda=1.5 case has an exact FULL solution but the explicit-start active-set Picard sequence enters a two-cycle spanning FULL and CURTAILED regimes.
Reducing dt in the same physical parameter set to lambda<1 removes that preregistered cycle and yields convergence to the exact oracle.

experiments.A1: DUMMY-05 FULL, CURTAILED and ZERO oracle solutions are fixed points of the active-set map
experiments.A2: any interior CURTAILED exchange guess maps in one evaluation to the exact curtailed exchange
experiments.A3: within a non-switching subcritical FULL regime the error ratio is -lambda
experiments.A4: the preregistered lambda=1.5 case reproduces the FULL/CURTAILED two-cycle despite an admissible exact FULL solution
experiments.A5: all iterates respect 0<=U<=R even in the nonconvergent cycle
experiments.A6: same physical parameters with dt=0.2, lambda=0.3 converge toward the exact DUMMY-05 solution
experiments.A7: cycle states satisfy their own provisional balance and management clipping rules, showing that local rule compliance is insufficient for coupled convergence
experiments.A8: physical-datum crossing by a provisional iterate fails closed rather than being hidden by management clipping

forbidden: no damping or Newton repair in DUMMY-06
no empirical convergence tolerance as an admission criterion
no claim that this naive active-set Picard map represents Ribasim or iMOD Coupler implementation
